afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KBOU 271111 AFDBOU Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Denver/Boulder CO 511 AM MDT Mon Jul 27 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - Some relief from the heat today, with increasing chances of showers and afternoon/evening thunderstorms. - Scattered to numerous showers and storms with locally heavy rain Tuesday and Wednesday. Temperatures settle back closer to normal. - Drying out again

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION...Today and tonight... Temperatures will be cooler but still several degrees above normal given a very warm start to the day. Humidity values will have a bump up due to more clouds, monsoonal moisture, and the slight cooling. Minimum RHs are expected to stay above 25% in most locations, and above 35% over the mountains and higher foothills. A few light showers/sprinkles will occur over
